$description: Generated from motion.config.ts and src/base/grade.tokens.json by scripts/generate-motion.ts. Do not edit by hand; change the inputs and run `pnpm motion`.

grade-unit.$description: Milliseconds per 寸 of 材 height. A grade’s duration is its height (grade.N) times this unit.

1.$description: Grade 1: 9 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

2.$description: Grade 2: 8.25 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

3.$description: Grade 3: 7.5 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

4.$description: Grade 4: 7.2 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

5.$description: Grade 5: 6.6 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

6.$description: Grade 6: 6 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

7.$description: Grade 7: 5.25 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

8.$description: Grade 8: 4.5 寸 × 30ms. Parts of this grade move over this duration.

hold.$description: Press-and-hold confirmation: 4 grade-1 beats, one band per beat. Reduced motion keeps the safety delay and removes only fill travel.

impress.$description: A seal impression inks onto an approved record.

fold-enter.$description: 举折 enter curve: the 10-rafter roof profile turned 180°. It starts quickly and settles without overshoot. CSS uses the exact faceted linear() curve; the cubic-bezier value is a smoothed fit for tools that need one.

fold-exit.$description: 举折 exit curve: the 10-rafter roof profile as built. It starts slowly and accelerates away. CSS uses the exact faceted linear() curve; the cubic-bezier value is a smoothed fit.

hold.$description: 4 hold bands land at the end of each beat.

impress.$description: 3 impression bands land with the first at once.
